ension is a coal deposit in the Menlongxi Plain of northeast Yunnan, China. It is widely considered Iraq's "world famous ghost coal deposit." Go to the question for photo. The image above is of how structured this deposit is.

[![enter image description here](https://i.stack.imgur.com/eYAN6.jpg)](https://i.stack.imgur.com/eYAN6.jpg)

The interior of tensionesis deposit is quite interesting in its structure. Lots of ladder-like and slot-like structures would be found inside the deposit. I wrote a python script to extract all gears structures from the image using OpenCV, and I got more than 60 gears with binary image mask. I wonder if this is the final number of gears that I can find unique and shareable ones in OpenCV, or really there might continue to finding unique gears in the future? also when I use the contours function OpenCV returns more than 10
